plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Residential Construction, Basic Technical Certificate' program page (Major Code: 4541V), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/trade-and-industry-department/residential-construction/residential-construction-basic-technical-certificate . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the published requirement tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals).  TRUE award: Basic Technical Certificate (page title). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 9, the catalog's published total ('Total Credit Hours: 9'); the single-semester table sums exactly. Variable credit: 'CABW 200I Cabinetmaking Independent Study 1-3 Credits' modeled at 3 credits - the value required for the semester to sum to the catalog's published total of 9 (3+3+3). Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
